sources.quote: finds buyers spend only about 17 percent of the journey meeting suppliers
sources.title: Why B2B Sales Needs a Digital-First Approach
sources.evidence: Gartner research shows buyers typically only spend 17% of their time meeting with potential suppliers when considering a purchase.

sources.quote: Public Services and Procurement Canada's Buy Canadian Policy took effect in December 2025
sources.title: Government of Canada implements Buy Canadian Policy to strengthen Canada’s economy and support homegrown industries - Canada.ca
sources.evidence: Effective December 16, 2025, the Government of Canada rolled out the new Buy Canadian Policy for federal procurement. The policy sets clear direction for federal departments and agencies to prioritize Canadian suppliers and Canadian content in their purchasing decisions.

sources.quote: reimburses up to half of eligible costs to a maximum of $50,000 per project
sources.title: CanExport SMEs 2026-2027: complete applicant’s guide - Tradecommissioner.gc.ca
sources.evidence: Applicants must request between $10,000 and $50,000 CAD in CanExport SMEs funding per project. Because the program funds up to 50% of eligible costs, the total project value must fall between $20,000 and $100,000 CAD.

sources.quote: as at least 51 percent plus the last substantial transformation here
sources.title: “Product of Canada” and “Made in Canada” Claims
sources.evidence: For a Made in Canada claim, at least 51% of the total direct costs of producing or manufacturing the good must have been incurred in Canada, the last substantial transformation must have occurred in Canada, and the claim must be accompanied by a qualifying statement such as Made in Canada with imported parts. For a Product of Canada claim, at least 98% of the total direct costs must have been incurred in Canada.

sources.quote: the parties may be bound by an English version only after the French one has been provided and they expressly choose it
sources.title: Section 55 Disposition versions - Légis Québec
sources.evidence: Contracts pre-determined by one party and the related documents must be drawn up in French. The parties to such a contract may be bound only by its version in a language other than French if, after its French version has been remitted to the adhering party, such is their express wish.

sources.quote: penalties reach $10 million per violation for organizations
sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions about Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation | CRTC
sources.evidence: The maximum amount of an administrative monetary penalty (AMP) per violation for an individual under CASL is $1 million, and for a business it is $10 million.

sources.quote: require an environmental product claim to rest on adequate and proper testing
sources.title: Environmental claims and the Competition Act
sources.evidence: The Competition Act provisions prohibit claims about the environmental benefits of a product that are not based on adequate and proper testing, and prohibit claims about the environmental benefits of a business or business activity that are not based on adequate and proper substantiation.

sources.quote: Since June 2025, private parties can seek leave to bring claims at the Competition Tribunal
sources.title: Environmental claims and greenwashing
sources.evidence: Starting June 20, 2025, people can directly apply for permission to file an application against businesses under the deceptive marketing practices provisions of the Act.

flags.quote: a net-zero style claim to rest on an internationally recognized methodology
flags.issue: Outdated. The Competition Bureau states that on March 26, 2026 the Budget 2025 Implementation Act, No. 1 received Royal Assent and removed the requirement that environmental claims about a business or business activity be substantiated in accordance with an internationally recognized methodology. Claims must still rest on adequate and proper testing or substantiation.
